summary:
Implementation plan to integrate native Firebase Auth Email Link verification for Two-Factor Authentication during sign-in:
1. Implement Firebase official sendSignInLinkToEmail to dispatch authentic sign-in verification emails directly to the resident's registered Gmail (carinok92@gmail.com), matching the proven reliability of password reset emails.
2. Build auto-detection for email link callbacks when residents click the verification link in their Gmail.
3. Connect backend session authorization (/api/auth/firebase-email-link-login) to issue JWT tokens upon successful Firebase link validation.
4. Maintain dual fallback on the 2FA screen with 6-digit passcode entry and direct Google Sign-In.
